title: GigaChat-2 (Light)
notes: Configure the endpoint and credentials through the declared environment variables. Connection reuse can affect effective concurrency limits. Provider eval_concurrency is informational; configure the client limit with LLM_MAX_CONCURRENT.

title: Gemma-4 31B (on)
notes: Direct Cerebras has no reasoning_field (403; the client then reads both known names) and is last because of its rate limit; LLMGW is the intended path. Credential-based selection does not check health. polza-cerebras is omitted here: the pin exposed no reasoning channel.

title: Gemma-4 31B (off)
notes: Direct Cerebras has no reasoning_field and is last because of its rate limit; LLMGW is the intended path. Credential-based selection does not check health. polza-cerebras pins cerebras/fp16; keep it last and opt-in through gemma4-31b-roff@polza-cerebras. The 40960 output ceiling is required (41000 returned a misleading 400). That pin has no reasoning_off/reasoning_field: it exposed no reasoning channel.

title: Gemma-4 26B-A4B (on)
notes: SiliconFlow requires chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking. Hugging Face Router needs the explicit field so the paired configuration stays symmetric.
sanitize_enums is required: numeric enums and nullable type unions fail on Cherry, Polza, and AIHubMix.

providers.name: hf-router
providers.notes: This gateway rejects vendor body keys with HTTP 400 extra-argument errors. The client retries without them, but structured requests then return HTTP 500.

title: Qwen3.6 35B-A3B (off)
notes: Reasoning model: without disable_reasoning, it returns empty content with finish_reason=length.

Without disable_thinking_for_tools the first structured call gets a 400 thinking/tool_choice conflict. The workaround is per instance, so per-request clients pay repeatedly. Reasoning-off siblings do not need this flag.
